_comment: VS14 Robust.Cdn config — JSON not YAML because Robust.Cdn's Program.cs only loads the ASP.NET default config sources (no AddYamlFile). Secrets (UpdateToken) come via env vars set in ops/observability/docker-compose.yml.

vacation-station._authComment: vs-2f8.1 H1 (human): UpdateToken is the bearer token Tools/publish_multi_request.py sends with Authorization: Bearer <token>. ASP.NET config supports env-var override via __ separator, and ops/observability/docker-compose.yml already wires Manifest__Forks__vacation-station__UpdateToken from ${CDN_UPDATE_TOKEN}. The placeholder below documents the JSON slot for clarity but is OVERRIDDEN by the env var at runtime — never commit a real token here. To activate publishing: (1) generate a 32-byte hex token (openssl rand -hex 32), (2) add CDN_UPDATE_TOKEN=<token> to ops/observability/.env on the host, (3) docker compose up -d cdn, (4) register the same token as PUBLISH_TOKEN GitHub Actions secret on azigler/vacation-station-14.
